blurb: Guests explore marine science through guided tours, hands-on labs, and interactive exhibits including live animals and a large blue whale skeleton. The center offers educational programs for school groups, summer youth camps, and private event rentals. It is operated by UC Santa Cruz and located on the Monterey Bay coast.
